name: Corn Term Structure Dashboard
description: ZC (Corn) futures term structure research dashboard focused on the M1–M2 calendar spread, contango/backwardation regime analysis, and annualized carry cost. Uses NoAdjustment with FirstOfMonth rollover. Key metrics: M1–M2 spread (cents/bu), annualized carry (52/10.4 ≈ 5x scaling for ~5 contracts/year), and rolling 1-year contango frequency. Dashboard includes snapshot summary table, spread and carry line charts, regime frequency chart, and monthly seasonal bar chart.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN (ZC) TERM STRUCTURE DASHBOARD
# =============================================================================
# Focus: M1–M2 spread, contango/backwardation regime, annualized carry cost
#
# Data: ZC via market_data_source + futures_continuation
#   - NoAdjustment preserves actual price levels for spread analysis
#   - spread_depth=1 gives M1 - M2 calendar spread
#   - cont.carry = (M1/M2) - 1: positive = backwardation, negative = contango
#
# Annualization: ZC has 5 delivery months/year (Mar, May, Jul, Sep, Dec)
#   → avg ~10.4 weeks between expirations → factor = 52 / 10.4 = 5
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: ZC Corn Futures ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

zc_close = cont.c
m1_m2_spread = cont.spread
carry_raw = cont.carry

# --- Derived: Annualized carry ---
# 5 contracts/year → 52/10.4 ≈ 5x annualization factor
carry_annualized = carry_raw * 5.0

# --- Regime flags ---
is_contango = m1_m2_spread < 0
is_backwardation = m1_m2_spread > 0

# --- Regime label (String) for summary table ---
# where_string: returns value where condition is true, fill where false
regime_str = where_string()(is_contango, 'Contango', 'Backwardation')

# --- Cumulative averages (period-agnostic) ---
avg_spread = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(m1_m2_spread)
avg_carry_ann = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(carry_annualized)

# --- Rolling 1-year contango frequency ---
# ma(252) on boolean (auto-cast to 0/1) gives fraction in contango
contango_frac = ma(period=252)(is_contango)
contango_pct = contango_frac * 100.0

# --- Calendar month for seasonal analysis ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table (category '1. Snapshot')
# Rows: [Spread, Carry]  Cols: [Current, 3Yr Avg, Regime]
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZC Corn Term Structure Snapshot',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Spread', 'Carry'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'Avg', 'Regime'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0 (Spread): Current M1-M2 spread | Avg spread | Regime label
            ColumnSpec(info='M1–M2 Spread (cents/bu)', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Cumulative Avg Spread', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Current Regime', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
            # Row 1 (Carry): Current ann. carry | Avg ann. carry | Rolling contango freq
            ColumnSpec(info='Annualized Carry (%)', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Avg Annualized Carry (%)', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Rolling 1Yr Contango Freq (%)', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Snapshot',
    order=0
)(m1_m2_spread, avg_spread, regime_str, carry_annualized, avg_carry_ann, contango_frac)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: M1–M2 Calendar Spread over time (category '2. Spread')
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='ZC M1–M2 Calendar Spread (cents/bu)',
    category='2. Spread',
    y_axis_label='Spread (cents/bu)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Flat')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='M1–M2 Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative Avg', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(m1_m2_spread, avg_spread))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Annualized Carry Cost over time (category '2. Spread')
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Annualized Carry Cost (%)',
    category='2. Spread',
    y_axis_label='Carry (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Annualized Carry', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative Avg', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(carry_annualized, avg_carry_ann))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Rolling 1-Year Contango Frequency (category '3. Regime')
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 1-Year Contango Frequency (%)',
    category='3. Regime',
    y_axis_label='Contango Freq (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=50.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% Neutral'),
        ReferenceLine(value=75.0, color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='75% Strongly Contango'),
        ReferenceLine(value=25.0, color=Color.Teal, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='25% Strongly Backwardated')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Contango Freq', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(contango_pct,))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 5: Average M1–M2 Spread by Month (category '3. Regime')
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Avg M1–M2 Spread by Month (Seasonal Pattern)',
    category='3. Regime',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Avg Spread (cents/bu)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    order=4
)(values=m1_m2_spread, label=month_num)
